verdict.rationale: Bento has a dashboard with out-of-the-box views of cost per run, tool failure rates, drift, and regressions across deploys. Releases are scored against production history, and the CLI can pull analytics as raw JSON, so you could build dashboards externally as a workaround. Nothing shows user-defined custom dashboards, and latency is never mentioned. Missing for 10: custom dashboard builder or widget configuration, explicit latency metrics, eval-score charting, independent or hands-on corroboration.
